changelog:
- Added Nunchuk Input Viewer (Credits to Bodacious and Hintz for this!)
 - Added ranking details page when on the WFC Main Page, which can be accessed by pressing +.
 - Fixed an issue where selecting "Next Race" could cause the game to crash.
 - Fixed an issue where GP points would be wrong on NTSC-J.
 - Fixed an issue where randomizing a course in Battle Worldwides could select a CT.
 - Fixed an issue where the track repick prevention UI would remain when going offline.
 - Other minor bug fixes and improvements.
